notices.text: Industrial action: Waterways Ireland locks and lifting bridges on the Shannon will not operate on Thursday 12 November 2026. Allow extra time on adjacent days.
notices.title: Shannon locks and bridges closed 12 Nov (industrial action)

notices.text: Apply and pay €63.50 online by 1 November. Power and water at public moorings off over the winter; the 5-day rule applies otherwise.
notices.title: Winter mooring 1 Nov 2026 to 31 Mar 2027

notices.text: ESB maintenance: no transit between the Shannon and Limerick at Ardnacrusha until the end of March.
notices.title: Ardnacrusha locks closed to 31 March 2027

notices.text: Stay in the marked channel, give markers a wide berth and plan for your draft. If grounded: engine off, lifejackets on, stay aboard, call 112 for the Coast Guard if you can't refloat.
notices.title: Low water and weed growth, all navigations

notices.text: Centre arch only; upstream boats give way to those coming down; 5 km/h within 200 m. Until September 2027.
notices.title: Hartley Bridge works, Carrick to Leitrim

notices.text: Everyone handling lines or gates, or aboard in the lock chamber or on the lock walls, must wear a PFD.
notices.title: Lifejackets compulsory at locks
